questions.question: When was lisinopril first started, and at what dose?
What was the patient's blood pressure before starting lisinopril?
Has dizziness or hypotension been documented previously on lisinopril or other antihypertensives?
Was the lisinopril dose increased from 10 mg to 20 mg, and if so, when and why?
Are there any documented allergies or adverse reactions to ACE inhibitors?
What follow-up actions were taken or planned after the dizziness episode (e.g., BP monitoring, dose adjustment, discontinuation)?
